svg.text: LLM ATTENTION ARCHITECTURE: MHA VS. GQA-8 VS. MLA (MATRIX ABSORPTION) VS. HYBRID LINEAR
MLA Weight Matrix Absorption (`FlashMLA`) Compresses KV 4.67x vs. GQA & Hits 66.8% TensorCore Util
8x H200 @ 32K Context: Tier 1 MHA (1,310 KB/tok, 9 Sessions) vs. Tier 2 GQA-8 (163.8 KB/tok, 72 Sessions) vs. Tier 4 MLA (35.1 KB/tok, 236 Sessions)
⛔ Why MHA & Naive Unabsorbed MLA Choke on Long Context
1. MHA KV Explosion (`1,310.7 KB/tok` FP8 = `40 GB` per 32K Session):
• Storing 64 independent K & V heads (`2 * 80 * 64 * 128`) caps
an entire `8x H200` node at just `9` concurrent 32K sessions!
2. GQA-8 Low Decode Arithmetic Intensity (`AI = 16 FLOPs/Byte`):
• GQA-8 shares 1 KV head across 8 Query heads (`AI ≈ 8 * 2 = 16`),
which is 18x below H200's `295 FLOPs/B` TensorCore ridge point!
3. Naive MLA Without Matrix Absorption (Decompressing K/V in Decode):
• Materializing `128` heads of K/V from `c_KV` blows up HBM traffic
MHA vs. GQA-8 Limitations at 32K Context:
• MHA KV Footprint: 1,310.7 KB/tok (Only 9 sessions/node, $3.85/1M)
• GQA-8 KV Footprint: 163.8 KB/tok (72 sessions/node, $0.84/1M)
• GQA-8 Decode TensorCore Utilization: Only 14.5%
🏆 Tier 4: MLA Matrix Absorption (`FlashMLA`) & Hybrid Linear
1. Low-Rank Joint KV Compression (`d_c=512 + d_r=64 = 576/layer`):
• Caches only compressed latent vector `c_KV` (`512`) + decoupled
2. Weight Matrix Absorption (`W_UK` into `W_Q`, `W_UV` into `W_O`):
• Never materializes uncompressed K/V in Decode! All 128 Query heads
attend to 1 shared `c_KV` (`AI = 256 FLOPs/B` -> `66.8%` TensorCore!)
3. 7:1 Hybrid Linear + Full Attention (`Mamba-2 / Lightning + MLA`):
• 7 out of 8 layers use constant-size RNN state (`0 KB/tok` KV growth!)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (8x H200 @ 32K):
• KV Cache Size: 35.1 KB/tok FP8 (1.10 GB per 32K session!)
• Max 32K Sessions/Node: 236 (3.28x vs. GQA) | TensorCore: 66.8%
• Cost per 1M 32K-Context Tokens: $0.28 / 1M (-92.7% vs. MHA)
